answer: An identity is admitted only by posting a 500-token bond and holding a one-per-device credential registered to a unique atlas of attested hardware. A fake identity locks 500 tokens for 30 epochs, with 100% of the bond slashed on detection and no withdrawal before expiry. Splitting identities multiplies the locked capital per fake, and independent jurors drawn from a separate terrace of validators trace shared attestation roots to a common horizon.
